## Qiime2R Functions

read_qza() - Function for reading artifacts (.qza).
qza_to_phyloseq() - Imports multiple artifacts to produce a phyloseq object.
read_q2metadata() - Reads qiime2 metadata file (containing q2-types definition line)
write_q2manifest() - Writes a read manifest file to import data into qiime2
theme_q2r() - A ggplot2 theme for publication-type figures.
print_provenance() - A function to display provenance information.
is_q2metadata() - A function to check if a file is a qiime2 metadata file.
parse_taxonomy() - A function to parse taxonomy strings and return a table where each column is a taxonomic class.
parse_ordination() - A function to parse the internal ordination format.

```{r VennDiagrams}
#How many taxa in common do the three groups have?

phy<-qza_to_phyloseq("/decontam-sans-a-m-c-t-k.qza","rooted-tree.qza","taxonomy.qza","Tadpole_Metadata_All_Q2_NT.txt")
 if(taxa_are_rows(phy)){
        ps_melted <- reshape2::melt(otu_table(phy))
    } else {
        ps_melted <- reshape2::melt(t(otu_table(phy)))
    }
    ps_melted <- merge(ps_melted, sample_data(phy), by.x = "Var2", by.y = "row.names")
    ps_agg <- aggregate(as.formula(paste("value ~ Var1 +","Type")), data = ps_melted, function(x) (sum(x > 0)/length(x) >= 0) * mean(x))
    
        ps_mat <- reshape2::dcast(as.formula(paste("Var1 ~ ","Type")), data = ps_agg, value.var = "value")

#Presence/Absence only
ps_venn(phy,
        "Type",
        fraction = 0,
        weight = FALSE,
        relative = FALSE,
        plot = TRUE,
        fill = c("#b1e0d8","#e0b1d8","#a092e4"))
ps_venn

#Overlaps weighted by the abundances of those taxa 
ps_venn2(phy,
        "Type",
        fraction = 0,
        weight = TRUE,
        relative = FALSE,
        plot = TRUE,
        fill = c("#b1e0d8","#e0b1d8","#a092e4"))
ps_venn2

#With removing Control tanks (uninhabited tanks). All that is left is the D6 inhabited tank water samples, which 'match' the environment of the tadpoles at the time of their dissection.
phy2<-qza_to_phyloseq("/decontam-sans-a-m-c-t-k-w.qza","rooted-tree.qza","taxonomy.qza","Tadpole_Metadata_All_Q2_NT.txt")

#Presence/Absence only
pa_venn<-ps_venn(phy2,
        "Type",
        fraction = 0,
        weight = FALSE,
        relative = FALSE,
        plot = TRUE,
        fill = c("#b1e0d8","#e0b1d8","#a092e4"),
        quantities = list(type=c("counts","percent"), font = 6, round=2, cex=1.5),
        labels = list(cex=2))
ggexport(pa_venn, width = 5, height = 5, filename="pa_venn2.pdf", res=300)
pa_venn

#Overlaps weighted by the abundances of those taxa 
ra_venn<-ps_venn(phy2,
        "Type",
        fraction = 0,
        weight = TRUE,
        relative = FALSE,
        plot = TRUE,
        fill = c("#b1e0d8","#e0b1d8","#a092e4"),
        quantities = list(type=c("counts","percent"), font = 6, round=2, cex=1.2),
        labels = list(cex=2))
ggexport(ra_venn, width = 5, height = 5, filename="ra_venn2.pdf", res=300)
ra_venn

ra_venn2<-ps_venn(phy2,
        "Type",
        fraction = 0,
        weight = TRUE,
        relative = FALSE,
        plot = TRUE,
        fill = c("#b1e0d8","#e0b1d8","#a092e4"),
        quantities = list(type=c("percent"), font = 6, round=2, cex=1.5),
        labels = list(cex=2))
ggexport(ra_venn2, width = 5, height = 5, filename="ra_venn2-2.pdf", res=300)
ra_venn2
```
